description: Keep one thread as the planner and send every unit of work to its own worker thread. A watchdog checks new timeline work at the guard and block levels, records direct work the parent did itself, and sends up to three corrective messages or stops the turn. Toggle a thread from the composer, its + menu or `bb orchestrator-mode`, and switch the mode on for every new thread you start. Workers share the parent's environment and provider, so they need no extra service; requires bb 0.44 or newer.
